title: Rollops RolloutConfig
description: Declarative rollout configuration for a single service/target. Surface format is YAML; this schema is the published contract. Schema version is rollops.klarlabs.de/v1.

apiVersion.description: Schema version. A new major bumps this so configs migrate cleanly.

dependsOn.description: Target refs that must complete before this one.

schedule.description: RFC3339 future time to queue this rollout.

verification.description: Drift verification depth. shallow: stamped-checksum marker only (cheapest). detect (default): also live-diff against desired and ALERT on out-of-band field edits, without auto-correcting. full: same live diff and auto-reconcile drift back to desired (self-heal).

kind.description: Target plugin: ssh | ftp | kubernetes | <community plugin>.

criticality.description: Operator-set blast-radius weight feeding the risk gate.

env.description: Environment tag (e.g. dev | staging | prod) used for env-scoped RBAC grants.

spec.description: Target-specific desired state; validated by the target plugin.

promote.description: Whether this env participates in the staged promotion chain.

sensitive.description: CEL boolean expression; when true, forces human approval.

riskHistory.description: Optional recent rollback history signal for the risk gate. Lookback is a number of recent target history records.

lookback.description: Recent target history records to inspect. Zero disables the history signal.

weight.description: Additional normalized score weight assigned to rollback history.

maxFailures.description: Rollback count treated as maximum historical risk.

trigger.description: Optional CEL boolean expression that fires a rollback.

databaseRollback.description: Optional command hook run after manifest auto-rollback for database migration rollback.

timeout.description: Go duration for the rollback command.

databaseMigrate.description: Forward migration command with optional timing.

timeout.description: Go duration for the migration command.

when.description: pre-deploy (default) runs before the manifest is applied; post-promote runs after promotion.

database.description: Database lifecycle hooks: forward migration at deploy, reverse on rollback, and a backward-compatibility gate.

migrate.description: Forward migration. pre-deploy (default) runs before the new manifest is applied; post-promote runs after the rollout is promoted.

rollback.description: Reverse command run on any rollback. Supersedes the deprecated spec.rollback.database.

backwardCompatible.description: Whether the migration is safe to run the previous app version against. When false and no rollback command is set, a rollback is blocked unless forced.

healthCheck.description: Observability-free probe. Exactly one of http/tcp/command.

featureFlags.description: Couple the rollout to a feature-flag provider plugin; the flag percentage tracks the traffic weight.

plugin.description: Path to the flag plugin binary.

sha256.description: Required sha256 pin of the plugin binary.

when.description: When to drive the flag (default both).

imagePolicy.description: Registry-poll image automation: scan for newer tags of spec.target.spec.image and write a bump back to Git.

mode.description: Which version increments to auto-adopt. 'none' disables automation (the Git-committed image is authoritative).

pattern.description: Optional regexp filter on candidate tags.

allowedRegistries.description: Restrict image automation to these registry hosts (e.g. ghcr.io, docker.io). Empty means no restriction.

trafficRouting.description: Shift canary-weight of live traffic to the canary backend each step, via a built-in provider or a traffic-router plugin.

provider.description: Built-in router. Omit to use a plugin (plugin + sha256 then required).

plugin.description: Path to the traffic-router plugin binary (plugin mode).

sha256.description: Required sha256 pin of the plugin binary (plugin mode).

route.description: Router object name (e.g. Gateway API HTTPRoute).

kubeconfig.description: Kubeconfig path for the built-in router (optional; defaults to in-cluster).

context.description: Kube context for the built-in router (optional).

provider.description: prometheus (built-in) or a metricprovider plugin name.

plugin.description: Path to a metricprovider plugin binary (alternative to a built-in provider).

sha256.description: Required sha256 pin when plugin is set.

condition.description: CEL boolean over metric names; true == healthy.
